externalTools.name: Semgrep CE
externalTools.note: Invoked as a local CLI binary; not distributed with AceCheck. Semgrep states that software using the LGPL-2.1 engine may be shipped without a further license. Rules fetched by --config=auto are downloaded by your Semgrep install, not redistributed by AceCheck.

externalTools.name: Gitleaks
externalTools.note: Invoked as a local CLI binary; not distributed with AceCheck.

externalTools.name: OSV-Scanner
externalTools.note: Invoked as a local CLI binary; not distributed with AceCheck.

externalTools.name: ProjectDiscovery Nuclei
externalTools.note: Invoked as a local CLI binary; not distributed with AceCheck.

externalTools.name: OWASP ZAP
externalTools.note: Run via the official container image; not distributed with AceCheck.

externalTools.name: ffuf
externalTools.note: Invoked as a local CLI binary; not distributed with AceCheck.

externalTools.name: Nmap
externalTools.note: Invoked as a local CLI binary; not distributed with AceCheck. The NPSL restricts redistributing Nmap inside products, but it explicitly does not bind software that executes a copy of Nmap the end user has already installed or that parses its output, which is what AceCheck does.

externalTools.name: Docker Engine
externalTools.note: Used only to run the ZAP container on your machine.

externalTools.name: Google Chrome / Chromium
externalTools.note: Runtime requirement for the Lighthouse stage. Not distributed with AceCheck.
